title: Spectral mass outside a family
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and let $\mathcal F$ be a family of subsets of the coordinate set $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The spectral mass of $f$ outside $\mathcal F$ is the sum, over all subsets $S\notin\mathcal F$, of the real-valued spectral sample weight of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the n-dimensional Boolean cube
A set of subsets of the coordinate set
